task: Unseen E. coli host groups -> rank the same 94 named existing phages for observed source MLC > 0.
evidence_status: Already-inspected development cohort; no independent confirmation, model promotion, productive-infection probability or cocktail efficacy claim.

dataset.label_rule: Use reconciled observed source MLC > 0 only; keep all 41 unknown exclusions. Retain duplicate-genome source observations and all 94 named candidates; no phenotype-based deduplication.

b2_inner_selection.rule: Sort the 104 B2 outer-training host groups by SHA-256 of UTF-8 20261113:<host_group>, then group ID. First floor(104/5)=20 groups form inner validation; all other groups form inner fit. The committed manifest is authoritative.
b2_inner_selection.refit: Select each pooled model L2 using only inner validation, then refit once on all 115 B2 outer-training hosts. Primary-scenario selected L2 and B2 test labels never select B2 parameters.

annotation.primary: Regenerate scores from the bound 117-host JSON weights; do not refit or select on outer validation.
annotation.B2: Refit one logistic model per phage on all 115 training hosts.
annotation.features: Published 137 defense counts and four surface categories under the pinned source tables and host_features transform; this is an annotation proxy, not a mechanistic oracle.

host_4mer.operation: Refit one fixed logistic model per phage in each panel from bound raw host 4-mer vectors.
host_4mer.preprocessing: HostFeatureEncoder: means/scales over unique training host IDs only; prefix columns host_4mer:; no categorical features.

genophi.operation: Reuse the two complete frozen score matrices only; no feature selection, training or inference.
genophi.inherited_scope: Vocabulary includes all 177 host genomes and 94 phage genomes without labels; supervised selection/fitting uses outer-training labels only. This comparator is transductive in genome vocabulary, not an inductive-genome claim.
genophi.method_reference: genophi_protocol plus genophi_errata and genophi_provenance input roles

pooled_sequence.operation: New fits under matching host-only split and all 94 library phages, using paired_interaction functions.
pooled_sequence.features: Bound 136-dimensional within-contig strand-canonical DNA 4-mer frequencies for both entities; no new extraction.
pooled_sequence.scaling: Separate host/phage scalers fitted on unique fit assembly digests only; validation/test vectors never contribute statistics. B2 full refit recomputes scalers on its 115 outer-training hosts.
pooled_sequence.weighting: Each observed named host-phage source observation has equal weight. Exact assembly duplicates remain separate source observations.
pooled_sequence.score: Fixed feature-order raw logits; never round scores or convert them to calibrated probabilities.
pooled_sequence.selection: For each kind: maximize complete-host macro Hit@2, then minimize capped tests at K=2, then prefer stronger L2; metric tie tolerance 1e-12. Grouped primary selection uses its 26 outer-validation hosts. B2 uses its frozen inner validation, then full outer-train refit.
pooled_sequence.initialization: Zero slopes; intercept logit of (weighted positives + 0.5)/(total weight + 1). Intercept is unpenalized.
pooled_sequence.failure: Stop on nonconvergence or gradient failure; do not expand the grid, replace features or change seeds.

metrics: MRR including zero for all-negative hosts
evaluation.cost_formula: E[min(T,K)] = K - sum(Hit@j, j=1..K-1); compute all intermediate j through 4 for K=5. One candidate test is one equal-cost unit; batching, assay noise and clinical costs are excluded.
evaluation.ties: Exact expectation over uniform within-exact-score-tie permutations. Lexicographic display membership is separate and never substitutes for expected metrics.
evaluation.missingness: Score every host x all 94 candidates, including unknown-label pairs. Exclude an entire incomplete-label host from primary complete-panel metrics and report the exclusion; all-negative complete hosts remain. Never fill missing labels with zero or discard unscorable candidates.
evaluation.scoring_failure: Fail the required method on incomplete/nonfinite score support; report unavailable explicitly instead of silently changing the pool or comparison denominator.
evaluation.partitions: Retain primary validation and test plus B2 test; B2 has no outer validation. Keep inner B2 tuning metrics separately labeled. Never pool overlapping panels or treat them as independent.
evaluation.pair_classification: Pair AP/AUROC are optional diagnostics only; no selection or success gate may replace within-host ranking with pooled pair AP.

uncertainty.unit: Whole host genomic groups from the complete-host universe within each panel; paired draws shared across methods. Apply positive-eligible masks after drawing groups.
uncertainty.interval: Pointwise percentile intervals, unadjusted across secondary comparisons; conditional on this inspected cohort, fixed library and fitted models.

decisions.hit_gain: Record supported development Hit@2 gain only if the primary paired bilinear-minus-prevalence lower 95% bound exceeds zero; otherwise not established.
decisions.cost_gain: Record supported development cost savings only if the paired bilinear-minus-prevalence upper 95% cost-difference bound at K=2 is below zero.
decisions.tradeoff: Claim joint hit-and-cost benefit only when both criteria hold. Otherwise retain the hit/cost tradeoff or failure; never pick a different K after inspecting test outcomes.
decisions.release: No result here promotes a model. Independent reserved new-host data, applicable endpoint validation and a receiver policy are separate requirements.

environment_scope: Lock applies to newly generated scores and fits; inherited GenoPHI matrices and annotation weights retain their original recorded environments. Baseline refits here are new-task artifacts, not bitwise reproductions of earlier studies.
outputs: all validation trials and selection decisions
complete per-method host x phage score matrices
per-host ranking/cost metrics and support/exclusion ledger
paired host-group contrasts and all unfavorable subgroup outcomes
research-only report with no release claim
execution_boundary: Step 1 validates existing artifacts and freezes this specification; the training/scoring runner is step 2 and is not implemented or executed by this preflight.
